meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取和保存单细胞实验的带注释数据文件，方便在各分析工具之间传递矩阵。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做单细胞测序分析，需要读写带注释的矩阵数据文件。
copy.tagline_en: Read and write annotated single-cell matrices for analysis tools to share.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run single-cell sequencing analysis and need to read or write .h5ad files.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 Python 创建、读取、写出 .h5ad/.zarr 等注释矩阵文件，增删 obs/var 元数据，按条件取子集，或把多份数据集拼到一起。
howto.when: 当你处理 .h5ad 文件，或要把数据接到 scverse 生态（如 scanpy）时触发。它只管数据结构本身，分析流程等交给其他技能。

say.text: 帮我把 data.h5ad 读进来，看有多少细胞和基因

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can create, read and write annotated matrix files such as .h5ad and .zarr in Python, add or remove obs/var metadata, subset by conditions and concatenate datasets.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with .h5ad files or connect data to the scverse ecosystem, e.g. scanpy. It covers the data format only; analysis workflows are left to other skills.
